description: List the grammar points of an HSK level in the order GraphChinese teaches them, which respects what each point needs first. Each has a summary and the slug that get_grammar_point takes. Use this when the user asks which sentence patterns to learn first, or what grammar to study at their level. Do not use it to explain one pattern (use get_grammar_point).

count.description: How many points to return. Default 10.

name: get_grammar_order
title: Which grammar to learn first
